title: Start A Merch Brand With Zero Stock And An AI Helper
desc: Start an artist merch brand with no stock: guided setup or AI chat, real print-on-demand products, your own address.

sentences.text: Starting a merch brand sounds expensive.
With print on demand there's no stock to buy.
With an AI helper there's no developer to hire.
You choose products, add your logo, and set your prices.
Your store gets its own address, and you approve it before it goes live.
No big bill up front, and no boxes of stock at home.

chat.user: Merch brand for my band. Dark and minimal.
chat.ai: Great. Drafting your store for review.
